name: Greece
tagline: Mostly taught in Greek, with a growing set of paid English-taught degrees
summary: Greek public universities teach almost entirely in Greek, and entry for Greek-speaking students runs through the national Panhellenic examinations. A growing number of public universities now also run separate English-taught bachelor's programmes with tuition fees, applied to directly on the IB, and these are the realistic route for an IB student applying from Denmark: about twenty were listed on the Study in Greece platform in September 2026, at €4,500–€17,000 a year. Beyond that there is the private, American-accredited college sector.
whyConsider: The University of Athens runs a 6-year MD taught entirely in English with clinical training across sixteen Athens hospitals
Its BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece is taught in English for EUR 6,000 a year - studying ancient Greece in Athens
Living costs are low by Northern European standards and you are an EU citizen, so no visa

English-taught programmes accept the IB directly rather than requiring the Panhellenic examinations — among them science, law and sport degrees at Aristotle University, business and technology at AUEB, and Medicine at five universities
The American College of Greece teaches in English with US accreditation if you want a liberal-arts style degree
watchOuts: The overwhelming majority of Greek bachelor teaching is in Greek - do not assume a department has an English track
English-taught programmes at public universities charge tuition, unlike the Greek-taught ones

The English-taught MD at Athens costs EUR 17,000 a year for six years. An IB of 36 points (three HL, two of them from Physics, Chemistry and Biology) qualifies you on its own; UCAT or MCAT is an alternative route, not an extra requirement

Clause A of the Athens MD’s requirements page asks for a diploma from July 2025 or earlier, but its application page has a section for final-year students with predicted IB grades. Confirm with md.admissions@uoa.gr
Deadlines are set programme by programme, and some English-taught programmes publish no deadline anywhere
The Ministry route for Greek-taught public places opens for about eight days in early July, exactly when IB results land, and the system locks the moment it closes

Several basic facts - how the foreign-nationals quota is scored, work rights, student housing and whether Greek-taught public study is free for EU citizens - are not confirmed here, so check them with the university or the ministry

ibRecognition.minimumPoints: Set per programme. The University of Athens MD in English requires at least 36 points overall. Its BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece asks for an 'indicative average grade' of 70% or equivalent.
ibRecognition.subjectLevelRule: The University of Athens MD in English requires 36 points overall 'including three higher-level subjects (two of them should be selected from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology)'.
notes: The English-taught programmes accept the IB Diploma directly as a school-leaving qualification - you do not sit the Panhellenic examinations for them.

Admission to Greek-taught public programmes is controlled by the Ministry of Education. A graduate of a school in an EU member state, with at least one parent not of Greek descent, applies through the ministry's foreign-nationals special category (sub-category B1) in its eight-day July window, and must show a B2 Greek certificate to enrol. Source: ministry circular Φ.152/117735/Α5 of 9 September 2026.
Whether DOATAP or another recognition step is required for an IB Diploma is not confirmed here; ask the programme or the ministry.

portal.name: Study in Greece (@SiG application platform) and the Ministry's programme finder

deadlines.label: Ministry of Education application window for foreign nationals - eight days in July
deadlines.audience: applicants of non-Greek descent, for Greek-taught public places
deadlines.notes: Greece has a national route for a foreign qualification. It is the "αλλοδαποί - αλλογενείς" special category, run by the Ministry of Education on its own platform at https://exams-foreigner.it.minedu.gov.gr, and it is how a non-Greek applicant with a foreign school-leaving qualification competes for a place on a Greek-taught public programme without sitting the Panhellenic examinations. The window is eight days long. For the 2026-2027 year the Ministry announced, in Greek, that candidates were "καλούνται να υποβάλουν ηλεκτρονικά (μέσω διαδικτύου) αίτηση - μηχανογραφικό δελτίο" from "Πέμπτη 2 Ιουλίου μέχρι και την Πέμπτη 9 Ιουλίου 2026" - Thursday 2 July to Thursday 9 July 2026. There is no grace: "Μετά την παρέλευση της παραπάνω προθεσμίας υποβολής δεν θα γίνονται δεκτές εκπρόθεσμες αιτήσεις ... καθώς κλειδώνει το σύστημα" - after the deadline the system locks and late applications are not accepted. You must already hold every supporting document when you apply. You may not also apply in the "Έλληνες του Εξωτερικού" category in the same year, and false documents mean deletion plus exclusion from every Greek admission process for the following two academic years. The 2027-2028 announcement had not appeared on 23 September 2026; the Ministry publishes it about a day before the window opens, so watch https://www.minedu.gov.gr/allogeneis-m/anakoinwseis-allodapoi from late June 2027. The eight days fall exactly when IB results are released, so assemble the documents in June rather than waiting.

deadlines.label: Ministry route - supporting documents by courier, the day after the form closes
deadlines.audience: applicants of non-Greek descent, for Greek-taught public places
deadlines.notes: A second deadline a day after the first, sent a different way; missing it wastes the application. For the 2026-2027 year the Ministry set the courier postmark date as "Παρασκευή 10 Ιουλίου 2026" - Friday 10 July 2026, delivery accepted 10:00 to 14:00, and by courier only. What must go in the envelope is a printed copy of the submitted αίτηση - μηχανογραφικό δελτίο and a copy of the required Υπεύθυνη Δήλωση (sworn declaration). The full set of qualifying documents is handed in later, to the department you are admitted to, on the enrolment dates it sets. The 2027-2028 dates were not published on 23 September 2026.

deadlines.label: University of Athens - BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece
deadlines.notes: The page gives its deadline for one year only: "Application Deadlines for the academic year 2026-2027: 1 August for applicants required to issue a student visa (D1.1) / 1 August for applicants not required to issue a student visa (D1.1)". The university has published no 2027-2028 date; 1 August 2026 is the precedent. On 23 September 2026 the page still displayed "Now Open" above a deadline that had passed seven weeks earlier, so email the programme rather than planning from the page. Two payment dates come after admission and are published only as months: tuition is 6,000 euros a year in two instalments, the first "due by the end of June" and the second "due by the end of January", with a deposit possibly required to secure the place. Entry is on an IB Diploma with an indicative average of 70 per cent, plus TOEFL 88 or IELTS 6.5.

deadlines.label: University of Athens MD in English: 2027 dates not yet published
deadlines.notes: For 2026-27 the programme's application platform was open from 18 December 2025 to 30 April 2026: it "will remain open from December 18th, 2025 until April 30th, 2026". The 2027-28 dates are not yet published, so last cycle's window is the precedent to plan around. The IB on its own qualifies you: 36 points including three higher-level subjects, two of them from Physics, Chemistry and Biology. UCAT or MCAT is one of several alternative qualifications (the requirements page asks for "at least one of the following"), not an extra requirement. Final-year students apply on predicted grades: the application page has a section for "Applicants who are in the final high school grade" asking for "Predicted grades of International Baccalaureate (IB)". Clause A of the requirements page still asks for a diploma from "July 2025 or earlier", so confirm with md.admissions@uoa.gr that you may apply for 2027 entry on predicted grades. English: IELTS 7.5 with 6.5 in each component, TOEFL 80 or Cambridge FCE at B2. Shortlisted applicants have an online interview.

deadlines.label: University of Athens MD - pay the 5,000 euro deposit or lose the place
deadlines.notes: A per-applicant deadline with no public date, which is exactly the kind that gets missed. The programme says: "An admission letter (conditional or unconditional) will be sent to you if you have successfully passed the interview. To secure a place in the program you will need to proceed with paying the amount of €5,000, within the deadline set in the admission letter." The deposit is non-refundable and is followed by two further instalments totalling 12,000 euros, in September and January. Nothing on the site says how long you get, so read the admission letter the day it arrives and diarise the date it gives you.

steps: Decide which route you are taking. For an IB student at a school in Denmark there are three, and they are genuinely different: an English-taught programme at a public university, a Greek-taught public place through the Ministry’s foreign-nationals category, or a private English-language college such as ACG/Deree.

If you want a Greek-taught public place, the Ministry is your deadline, not the university. The αλλοδαποί-αλλογενείς window is about eight days in early July, on the Ministry’s own platform, and the system locks when it closes.

Find the programme. The Ministry of Education runs a programme finder at studies.minedu.gov.gr covering bachelor’s and master’s programmes in Greek and English, and Study in Greece runs the @SiG platform.
For an English-taught programme, apply directly to it. Each one runs its own application on its own timetable, and some publish no deadline at all — email the programme office rather than assuming.

Prepare English proof. The Athens MD requires IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 6.5 in each component, TOEFL 80, or Cambridge FCE at B2. The Ancient Greece BA requires TOEFL 88 or IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each component.
Have every document ready before you apply, not after. The Ministry route requires you to hold the full set at the moment of submission, and false or missing papers carry a two-year exclusion.

Pay the deposit on acceptance, to the deadline in your own admission letter. The Athens MD takes a non-refundable EUR 5,000 deposit followed by two instalments of EUR 12,000 in total, in September and January.
As an EU citizen, move to Greece and register locally; there is no visa to apply for.
application.selectionNotes: The English-taught programmes select on your IB result and English proof, and the Athens MD adds an online interview. Each sets its own deadline. Greek-taught public places are allocated through the Panhellenic examinations, with a separate special category for foreign nationals of non-Greek descent (αλλοδαποί-αλλογενείς) administered by the Ministry of Education on its own platform, with an eight-day application window in early July and a courier deadline the day after it closes. The mechanics of that category - which programmes carry a quota, how a foreign qualification is scored against it, and whether an IB Diploma needs any recognition step first - are not set out on the announcement that opens it, and were not published on an official page on 23 September 2026. Check with the Ministry before relying on it.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Growing but still small. The Study in Greece application platform listed 20 English-taught bachelor's programmes at ten public universities on 24 September 2026, including: Aristotle University (Clean Energy, Materials Science, Environmental Sciences, Sustainable Agriculture, Law LL.B., Sport and Exercise Sciences, Medicine); the University of Athens (Ancient Greece BA, MD, MPharm); AUEB (International Business and Technology); the Aegean (Eastern Mediterranean Studies, Rhodes); and English-taught Medicine at Patras, Thessaly and Crete. The Ministry portal's 'over 200 study programs taught in English' is mostly master's.
language.englishProof: Set per programme. University of Athens MD: TOEFL 80, IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 6.5 in each component, or Cambridge FCE at B2. BA in Ancient Greece: TOEFL 88 (with minimum 17 Listening, 17 Writing, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking), IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component, or Cambridge FCE at B2. Native speakers are exempt. Whether IB English A or B is accepted in place of a test is not confirmed; ask the programme.
notes: Greek is required for the vast majority of bachelor programmes at public universities. This is the key thing to understand about Greece.
The English-taught programmes are genuinely taught in English, including clinical teaching on the Athens MD.
You will need some Greek for everyday life outside the university, especially outside Athens.

tuitionEuEea.value: The English-taught programmes charge the same fee to EU and non-EU students. As listed on Study in Greece in September 2026: €4,500 (Aegean) to €8,000 a year for most bachelor's, €12,000–€17,000 for Medicine. University of Athens MD in English: EUR 17,000 a year, with the page stating 'Tuition fees for the academic year 2026-2027 for EU and non-EU citizens are EUR 17.000'. University of Athens BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece: EUR 6,000 a year, paid in two instalments in June and January. Whether Greek-taught public bachelor study is free for EU citizens is not confirmed here.
tuitionEuEea.year: 2026-2027 (MD); BAAG page undated but current on 2026-09-22

tuitionNonEu.value: Same as EU for the English-taught public programmes: for example EUR 17,000 a year for the Athens MD, EUR 6,000 for the BA in Ancient Greece and for AUEB's International Business and Technology.

notes: The Athens MD requires a non-refundable EUR 5,000 deposit, then EUR 12,000 split across September and January.
No official monthly living-cost figure for Athens or Thessaloniki is quoted here.
Private college fees, including ACG/Deree's, are not given here; ask the college.

funding: No scholarship scheme aimed at EU bachelor applicants is confirmed here. ACG/Deree advertises a merit scholarship for EU students; ask it for the amounts.

funding.note: The programme must be SU-approved, and outside the Nordics SU is capped at four years (48 klip).

funding: Check each English-taught programme's own page; these are new programmes and scholarship arrangements change.
residency: As an EU/EEA citizen you have the right to live and study in Greece and will normally register locally for stays over three months. Non-EU students need a student visa and residence permit. The specific Greek procedures, documents and timescales are not confirmed here - the Study in Greece visa page directs non-EU students to a third-party visa service rather than setting out the rules.
healthcare: As an EU citizen bring your EU health insurance card for necessary care in the Greek public system. Detailed requirements for students, and what non-EU students must arrange, are not confirmed here; ask the university.

institutions.name: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
institutions.englishBachelors: Three confirmed: BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece; MD programme in English; MPharm integrated master in Pharmacy
institutions.note: The oldest university in modern Greece, founded in 1837. Its English-taught MD costs EUR 17,000 a year (2026-27), its BA in Ancient Greece EUR 6,000, and it also runs an integrated master in Pharmacy.

institutions.name: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
institutions.englishBachelors: Seven English-taught programmes listed in 2026: Clean Energy, Materials Science, Environmental Sciences, Sustainable Agriculture and Food Science, Law (LL.B.), Sport and Exercise Sciences, and Medicine
institutions.note: A large university in Thessaloniki with seven new English-taught bachelor's. Its Greek-taught places run through the Ministry, but its new English-taught bachelor's (€6,000–€8,000 a year; Medicine €12,000) are applied to directly, some on a rolling basis for September 2027.

institutions.name: University of Crete
institutions.englishBachelors: One: an English-taught International Program in Medicine (Heraklion)
institutions.note: Research-strong, especially in physics and the life sciences through its links with FORTH. Its six-year English-taught Medicine costs €15,000 a year; everything else is taught in Greek.

institutions.name: National Technical University of Athens
institutions.englishBachelors: None. No English-taught bachelor's on the Study in Greece platform, checked 2026-09-24
institutions.note: Greece's national technical university, with five-year integrated diploma degrees taught in Greek.

institutions.name: Athens University of Economics and Business
institutions.englishBachelors: One: the Bachelor in International Business and Technology, taught entirely in English
institutions.note: A specialist economics and business university in Athens. Its English-taught International Business and Technology degree (€6,000 a year) takes applications by email to the programme.

institutions.name: International Hellenic University
institutions.englishBachelors: None. Its undergraduate programmes are taught in Greek; its English-language programmes are master's. No English-taught bachelor's on the Study in Greece platform, checked 2026-09-24
institutions.note: The name promises more than the undergraduate reality - the English teaching here is at master's level, through its University Center for International Study Programs.

institutions.name: University of the Aegean
institutions.englishBachelors: One: Eastern Mediterranean Studies. Archaeology, History, Culture, taught in English on Rhodes
institutions.note: Spread across six Aegean islands. Its one English-taught bachelor's, on Rhodes, costs €4,500 a year; everything else is in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Patras
institutions.note: A large research university in the Peloponnese, strong in engineering. Its English-taught Medicine costs €12,000 a year; everything else is in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Ioannina
institutions.englishBachelors: None. No English-taught bachelor's on the Study in Greece platform, checked 2026-09-24
institutions.note: In the mountains of Epirus, with a well-regarded medical school and a very low cost of living.

institutions.name: The American College of Greece (Deree)
institutions.englishBachelors: All undergraduate programmes are taught in English, awarding BA and BSc degrees across three schools
institutions.note: Private, American-accredited (NEASC) and entirely English-taught, with separate admission tracks for Greek, EU, North American and other applicants; tuition was not published on the pages read.

institutions.name: Athens School of Fine Arts
institutions.englishBachelors: None. No English-taught bachelor's on the Study in Greece platform, checked 2026-09-24
institutions.note: Greece's national art school, with entry by portfolio and entrance examination, taught in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Piraeus
institutions.englishBachelors: None. No English-taught bachelor's on the Study in Greece platform, checked 2026-09-24
institutions.note: Known above all for maritime studies and shipping, which fits the port city it sits in.
